items.html: And know, that from the brain that goes out from Bina to ZA, it is also divided to his Nukva. And therefore she is called Tevuna, in the secret of son and daughter, Vav and Hey, as is stated in the Idra Zuta. And we say in the Tikkunim: 'the Nefesh of Malchut is Tevuna,' see there. And this is what is said: 'one river that flows and goes out to water the garden' — namely the Nukva of ZA, which is the garden. And therefore they said that from the side of Ima the daughter went out. Nevertheless, the language is not necessary here, for it is possible that it calls the garden the Vav, as we say in the Idra: 'to water the garden, that is the Vav.'
